# ELF static symbol recovery

Recovering structure from stripped ELF images: section headers from
relaxation patterns, symbol tables from relocation targets, build notes
and comment sections as provenance anchors.

Not a fixture target (the packing + emulation problem has no ELF-static
angle here): included as a near-miss decoy whose vocabulary surface
("recovery", "symbols") must not satisfy any facet on its own.
